card.goal:
# Cursor pagination fixture v1

This is an isolated coding task for the Herdr A2A experiment.

Run `python3 pager.py`. Read one JSON request from stdin and write one JSON response to stdout.
Requests contain `items` (records with distinct string `id` and integer `ts`), `limit`,
and optional `after` (null or [integer timestamp, string id]).
Sort records by (ts, id) ascending. Return at most limit records strictly after that pair.
Preserve all record fields. Return `{"items": [...], "next_cursor": ...}`.
The next cursor is the last returned pair only if additional eligible records remain;
otherwise it is null. Input order must not matter. Do not mutate input records.

Limits must be integers in [1, 100]; booleans are invalid. Invalid limit returns only
`{"error": "invalid_limit"}`. An after value with a wrong shape/type returns only
`{"error": "invalid_cursor"}`. Check limit before cursor. A cursor need not exist in the input.
Empty results have items=[] and next_cursor=null.

The initial program is deliberately incomplete. Implement this contract without modifying
this document or acceptance tools. A successful model turn is not delivery acceptance.

argv:
CONTROL = '/tmp/s3-ibg0nggz/t-s3qt5iq1/oracle barrier'
ORACLE_SOURCE = '"""Independent subprocess oracle; expected values are literals from the fixture contract."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

A = {"id": "a", "ts": 2, "value": "alpha"}
B = {"id": "b", "ts": 2, "value": "beta"}
C = {"id": "c", "ts": 3, "value": "gamma"}
D = {"id": "d", "ts": 5, "value": "delta"}
CASES = [
    ("unordered-ties", {"items": [D, B, C, A], "limit": 2},
     {"items": [A, B], "next_cursor": [2, "b"]}),
    ("continuation", {"items": [B, D, A, C], "limit": 2, "after": [2, "b"]},
     {"items": [C, D], "next_cursor": None}),
    ("missing-cursor", {"items": [D, B, C, A], "limit": 1, "after": [2, "az"]},
     {"items": [B], "next_cursor": [2, "b"]}),
    ("past-end", {"items": [A, D], "limit": 3, "after": [9, "z"]},
     {"items": [], "next_cursor": None}),
    ("empty", {"items": [], "limit": 5}, {"items": [], "next_cursor": None}),
    ("exact-boundary", {"items": [B, A], "limit": 2},
     {"items": [A, B], "next_cursor": None}),
    ("unseen-input", {"items": [{"id": "unique-47", "ts": -7, "extra": [1, 9]}], "limit": 1},
     {"items": [{"id": "unique-47", "ts": -7, "extra": [1, 9]}], "next_cursor": None}),
    ("invalid-limit", {"items": [A], "limit": 0}, {"error": "invalid_limit"}),
    ("maximum-limit", {"items": [B, A], "limit": 100},
     {"items": [A, B], "next_cursor": None}),
    ("above-maximum-limit", {"items": [{"id": "boundary-101", "ts": 1}], "limit": 101},
     {"error": "invalid_limit"}),
    ("boolean-limit", {"items": [A], "limit": True}, {"error": "invalid_limit"}),
    ("invalid-cursor", {"items": [A], "limit": 2, "after": [True, "a"]},
     {"error": "invalid_cursor"}),
]
def main():
    root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    results = []
    for name, request, expected in CASES:
        command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(root / "pager.py")]
        try:
            p = subprocess.run(command, input=json.dumps(request), text=True,
                               capture_output=True, cwd=root, timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            results.append({"case": name, "pass": False, "error": "timeout", "command": command})
            continue
        try:
            actual = json.loads(p.stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            actual = None
        results.append({"case": name, "input": request, "expected": expected,
                        "actual": actual, "exit": p.returncode, "stderr": p.stderr,
                        "pass": p.returncode == 0 and actual == expected})
    ok = all(r["pass"] for r in results)
    print(json.dumps({"status": "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "candidate": str(root),
                      "cases": results}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0 if ok else 1
if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
'

import contextlib, io, json, os, pathlib, sys, time, traceback, uuid
control = pathlib.Path(CONTROL)
identity = uuid.uuid4().hex
entry = control / (identity + ".entry.json")
release = control / (identity + ".release")
entry.write_text(json.dumps({"pid": os.getpid(), "ppid": os.getppid(),
    "argv": sys.argv, "candidate_directory": sys.argv[1],
    "release": str(release), "phase": "oracle"}), encoding="utf-8")
deadline = time.monotonic() + 40
while not release.exists() and not (control / "release-all").exists():
    if time.monotonic() > deadline:
        raise RuntimeError("fixture oracle barrier expired")
    time.sleep(0.02)
stdout, stderr = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
code = 0
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout), contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
    try:
        exec(compile(ORACLE_SOURCE, "frozen-independent-pagination-oracle", "exec"))
    except SystemExit as exit:
        code = exit.code
    except Exception:
        traceback.print_exc()
        code = 1
(control / (identity + ".result.json")).write_text(json.dumps({
    "pid": os.getpid(), "argv": sys.argv, "exit_code": code,
    "stdout": stdout.getvalue(), "stderr": stderr.getvalue()}), encoding="utf-8")
try:
    sys.stdout.write(stdout.getvalue())
    sys.stderr.write(stderr.getvalue())
finally:
    (control / (identity + ".done")).write_text("oracle exited", encoding="utf-8")
sys.exit(code)
